description: Expense policy for Acme Corp R&D division. Covers all expenses incurred during research, development, prototyping, and team operations. All expenses must be substantiated with receipts and aligned with the current project phase.

phases.name: Phase 1: Research & Prototyping
phases.description: Initial research, proof-of-concept development, hardware procurement, and team setup. Lab equipment and prototyping materials are expected. No client travel yet.
allowed: Lab equipment (oscilloscopes, soldering stations, measurement tools)
Prototyping materials (PCB fabrication, 3D printing filament, electronic components)
Software licenses (CAD, simulation tools, IDE subscriptions)
Cloud compute credits (AWS/GCP/Azure for model training)
Office equipment (monitors, keyboards, standing desks)
Technical books and research papers
Team lunch (max €25/person, 4x/month)
restricted: Conference travel — max 1 domestic conference per quarter
External consultants — max €5000/month, pre-approved SOW required

phases.name: Phase 2: Development & Testing
phases.description: Full-scale development, integration testing, and client pilot deployments. Team collaboration meals and conference attendance expected. Travel budget opens.
allowed: API credits and LLM inference costs (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic)
Cloud infrastructure (GPU instances, managed databases, CDN)
Testing devices (phones, tablets for QA — max 5 devices per team)
Team collaboration meals (max €40/person, 8x/month)
Domestic conference tickets and travel
Client meeting expenses (reasonable meals, parking)
Software subscriptions (monitoring, CI/CD, security scanning)
Co-working space day passes for remote team meetups
restricted: International conference — max 1 per quarter, €3000 budget cap
Equipment replacement — only if existing equipment is broken and out of warranty
forbidden: Gifts to clients over €50 without compliance approval

phases.name: Phase 3: Documentation & Handoff
phases.description: Final documentation, paper writing, client handoff, and project retrospective. Spending is primarily on documentation tools, printing, and a small celebration. No new hardware or travel.
allowed: Technical writing tools (documentation generators, diagram software)
Printing and binding of final reports
Academic journal submission fees
Open-source contribution support (domain registration, hosting)
Team retrospective dinner (max €60/person, one-time)
Cloud storage for final data archival
restricted: API credits — capped at €500 for final validation runs
